title: Tilt-excess decay on spt V gives a parameter-domain Campanato bound for the graph tangent projections (book 5.2 (10)-(11))
statement: Let n, l >= 0, U a subset of R^(n+l), V a rectifiable n-varifold in U in the sense of the contract (carrier M contained in U, multiplicity theta, theta H^n-integrable on M cap K for each compact K contained in U), mu := V.weight and p_w := V.tangentProj w. Let q be a linear isometry of R^(n+l), f : R^n -> R^l, S : R^(n+l) -> subspaces of R^(n+l), R > 0 and A, e arbitrary reals. Write F(x) := q(graphPoint x (f x)), Df(x) := fderiv f x and G(x) := the orthogonal projection (starProjection) of R^(n+l) onto (span{graphPoint v (Df(x) v) : v in R^n}).map q. Assume: (i) the closed ball B_R(0) of R^(n+l) is contained in U; (ii) f(0) = 0; (iii) f is 1-Lipschitz on the closed ball B^n_R(0); (iv) spt V cap B_R(0) = q(graphOver f (B^n_R(0))) cap B_R(0); (v) w -> p_w is mu-a.e. strongly measurable; (vi) for every Phi : R^(n+l) -> L(R^(n+l)) -> [0, infinity] with (w, P) -> Phi w P measurable and every measurable D contained in the open ball B^o_{R/2}(0) of R^n: lintegral_D Phi(F(x), G(x)) dx <= lintegral_{q(graphOver f D)} Phi(y, p_y) dmu(y); (vii) V.tiltExcess zeta s (S zeta) <= A (s/R)^e for every zeta in spt V cap B_{R/2}(0) and every 0 < s <= R/2. Then for every z in the closed ball B^n_{R/4}(0) and every 0 < s <= R/4: lintegral over the closed ball B^n_{s/2}(z) of ofReal(hsNormSq(G(x) - (S(F(z))).starProjection)) dx <= ofReal(A s^n (s/R)^e).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (S : Amb n ℓ → Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (R A e : ℝ), 0 < R → closedBall (0 : Amb n ℓ) R ⊆ U → f 0 = 0 → LipschitzOnWith 1 f (closedBall 0 R) → V.support ∩ closedBall 0 R = q '' graphOver f (closedBall 0 R) ∩ closedBall 0 R → AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → (∀ Φ : Amb n ℓ → (Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable (Function.uncurry Φ) → ∀ D : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet D → D ⊆ ball 0 (R / 2) → ∫⁻ x in D, Φ (q (graphPoint x (f x))) ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ f x v))).map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection ≤ ∫⁻ y in q '' graphOver f D, Φ y (V.tangentProj y) ∂V.weight) → (∀ ζ ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall 0 (R / 2), ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ R / 2 → V.tiltExcess ζ s (S ζ) ≤ A * (s / R) ^ e) → ∀ z ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) (R / 4), ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ R / 4 → ∫⁻ x in closedBall z (s / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (hsNormSq (((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ f x v))).map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection - (S (q (graphPoint z (f z)))).starProjection)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (A * s ^ n * (s / R) ^ e)
